d:
After returning from his trip to London, Jethalal distributes special souvenirs to his neighbors. He gives Babita a requested makeup kit (and Iyer a red shirt), Doctor Hathi a slimming mirror, Roshan a toolkit, and gifts Bhide a full hair wig, leaving everyone amused.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
